entries.comment: Add password-gated art toggle and keep ENABLE_ART out of committed env.
Serve grid art from MonsterThumbnail and index image presence bits.
Stop serving creature art until ENABLE_ART is true or the password unlock cookie is set.
Support SQL Server on Linux and Windows
Add A-Z first-letter filter to creature search results.
Add creature system filter and feat source dedup
Use vwMonsterList when available and fall back to related monster art.
Improve port-in-use startup errors and simplify OpenAPI server URLs.
Serve monster art from MonsterImage table with cached thumbnails.
Add loadAoNImagePreview toggle and gitignore generated schema PNGs.
Add API docs UI with OpenAPI spec, Swagger try-it, and dbschema image library.
Add database maintenance scripts and schema documentation.
Improve grid keyboard nav, layout alignment, and search API reliability.
Serve built client from Express for production deploys
Added NPCs as a fifth home library with its own search page and API endpoint; Monsters search excludes NPCs.
Added Updates page with a development log sourced from git commit messages (no repository links).
Escape closes entity modals the same as the close button; nested MD and image popouts close first.
Expand PF2 search with NPCs, modals, updates, and keyboard nav
Left and right arrow keys browse previous and next result rows while a detail modal stays open.
Monster art double-click opens a full-size image popout scaled to fit the viewport with margin.
Navigation bar always shows all sections including the current page, with the active page highlighted.
Removed the Grid right/below layout toggle from Monsters and NPCs search; layout is fixed side-by-side for now.
Spell, Feat, and Equipment modals now match the Monster modal layout: description pane, markdown section, field grids, and image popout support.
Split markdown description extraction: monsters use lead paragraphs; spells, feats, and equipment pull prose after the first horizontal rule.
Add PF2 search pages
Add PF2 monster search app
Use Monster table for full-text search
Add Demiplane missing creature importer
Add Demiplane monster image importer
Skip failed Demiplane creature images
Add 1e beast scrapers and monster image import script.
